messages:
Alex: I have an Eames Aluminum Group management chair (black leather) + original ottoman — authentic vintage, minor patina on arms. Free for pickup in SF SOMA. Great condition for a classic office setup.
Mira: photos??
Alex: https://imgur.com/abcd123 (two pics). Leather has some age but no rips, casters replaced.
Sam: Size/weight? Might need help hauling down stairs.
Alex: It's hefty but doable with two people. Seat height ~17in, overall ~35in tall. Aluminum frame so solid. I can help carry to curb.
Kelly: Interested — can you hold until Friday evening?
Alex: Sure @Kelly, I can hold until 5pm Friday. If someone can pick it up earlier, post here.
Mira: Would pay for shipping if @Kelly can't make it. How much to crate it?
Alex: Crate/ship quotes I saw are roughly $120-200 depending on carrier. Happy to coordinate if you want it shipped.
Sam: Any interest in trades? I have a Varidesk Plus 36 (used, works great).
Alex: @Sam maybe — DM me pictures. Prefer to keep main thread for pickup coordination.
ops-bot: FYI — building pickup policy: reserve freight elevator via #facilities and pack items in labeled boxes. Link: https://redwood.company/facilities/pickups
Kelly: 👍 thanks, where exactly in SOMA?
Alex: 450 Bryant St, 12th floor. I'll meet at the loading dock. DM for access code.
Mira: I can do local pickup and cover $40 to help with handling — would that work?
Kelly: @Mira I can still swing by Friday but if you want it sooner feel free.
Alex: @Mira sold if you can pick up tonight before 8pm. Otherwise holding for @Kelly Fri.
Mira: I can pick up at 7:15pm tonight. Venmo or Zelle ok?
Sam: Nice snag, @Mira. That chair will last forever.
Kelly: No worries — hope it finds a good home.
Alex: Update: picked up by @Mira at 7:20pm. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
